integrity: The claim is proved by an explicit Kummer-borrow argument and strict lower-row exclusion. Congruence-one and congruence-minus-one overlaps are disclosed rather than presented as new subcases.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats only the large-prime regime \(p>m\), equivalently \(r_p(m)=1\). Finite replay checks support but do not replace the general proof. Literature searches cannot establish historical uniqueness.
title: Least extremal rows in the large-prime regime
